note: Gibson's house (guides/ps1.txt GIBSON'S HOUSE). Catherine lets nobody in until Gillian shows the JUNKER ID and answers her questions - her father's age (55) and, in the PS1 version, her measurements (81/58/83) - on a numeric pad.
